recommendation.recommendation: Continue exact V57 unchanged and audit the first eligible event immediately while collecting the first fully resolved HYPE long and short lifecycles.
recommendation.why_now: The runtime is healthy, the live economic sample is empty, and HYPE's direction asymmetry is the highest-value unresolved question.
recommendation.evidence_reviewed: Two immutable V57 prefixes and their delta, the exact V57 config and post-start acceptance, the continuous-improvement digest, HYPE aligned replay and exit challengers, SPCX development evidence, BTC chronological evidence, sweep path sensitivity, and the preregistered cadence schedule.
recommendation.observed_problem_or_opportunity: No V57 route has translated into an eligible signal or resolved lifecycle, so edge and realized execution remain unidentified; HYPE development is promising in aggregate but weak on short-side robustness.
recommendation.applicable_market_regime: All regimes observed prospectively under the frozen V57 route contracts; route conclusions require exact regime attribution when an eligible signal occurs.
recommendation.alternatives_considered: Relax HYPE alignment, remove compression gates, add fixed targets or trailing exits, re-enable SPCX longs, loosen BTC triggers, or keep V57 unchanged while collecting source-compatible evidence.
recommendation.expected_upside: Preserves the selected mechanisms while obtaining the evidence needed to distinguish real edge, side weakness, execution degradation, and ordinary variance.
recommendation.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Opportunity scarcity can remain economically impractical; the first lifecycle can lose; small samples can create false confidence; source or execution behavior can diverge only when a real signal fires.
recommendation.validation_completed: Exact identity, route coverage, ledger completeness, current venue flatness, entry-age diagnostics, non-entry attribution, historical fold and side sensitivity, and prior challenger dispositions.
recommendation.validation_still_required: Attributable eligible signals and resolved V57 lifecycles with realized costs, protection, exits, regime, excursion, and portfolio interactions.
recommendation.success_metrics: Every eligible event reconciles to an action or explicit withholding; each configured HYPE direction produces a complete lifecycle; realized costs stay within declared sensitivities; after-cost evidence survives largest-winner removal in a predeclared compatible window.
recommendation.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any missing route, stale or late eligible submission, unaccounted eligible event, unprotected fill, identity mismatch, corrupted ledger, unexpected leverage or exposure, or materially adverse exact lifecycle pattern requires immediate audit and an approval-ready containment or rollback proposal.

falsifiers: An eligible V57 event occurs without a routed action or explicit withholding outcome.
A V57 entry is submitted beyond its maximum configured age.
A venue fill is not protected by the intended reduce-only stop and any configured target.
A later complete audit shows missing route decisions, ledger corruption, source mismatch, or unexplained position state.
The HYPE route produces prospective side evidence materially inconsistent with the current long-dominant development diagnosis.
Zero entries persist to the 14-day review with complete technical coverage, requiring a cadence-deviation investigation rather than the current normal-scarcity diagnosis.
